2.text: And has listened [i.e., responded]<sup foot_note="228206">1</sup> to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]

footnotes.228206: - It will have heard Allāh's command and will have inclined immediately to compliance and willing obedience.

3.text: And when the earth has been extended<sup foot_note="228207">1</sup>

footnotes.228207: - i.e., stretched flat and spread out.

4.text: And has cast out that within it<sup foot_note="228208">1</sup> and relinquished [it]

footnotes.228208: - Of the dead and all else buried therein.

5.text: And has listened [i.e., responded] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] –

6.text: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion<sup foot_note="228209">1</sup> and will meet it.<sup foot_note="228210">2</sup>

footnotes.228209: i.e., striving throughout your life until you meet your Lord, hastening toward death.
footnotes.228210: i.e., you will find all that you intended and accomplished awaiting you in the Hereafter. Another meaning is "And will meet Him [i.e., your Lord]" and be recompensed in full by Him.

7.text: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,

8.text: He will be judged with an easy account

9.text: And return to his people in happiness.

10.text: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,

11.text: He will cry out for destruction

12.text: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.

13.text: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;

14.text: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allāh].

15.text: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever, of him, Seeing.

16.text: So I swear by the twilight glow

17.text: And [by] the night and what it envelops

18.text: And [by] the moon when it becomes full

19.text: [That] you will surely embark upon [i.e., experience] state after state.<sup foot_note="228211">1</sup>

footnotes.228211: - i.e., various stages, both in this life and in the Hereafter.

20.text: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,

21.text: And when the Qur’ān is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allāh]?

22.text: But those who have disbelieved deny,

23.text: And Allāh is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.

24.text: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,

25.text: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.
